questions.stem: A 72-year-old male presents with progressive memory decline and difficulty performing daily tasks. Neuroimaging shows significant atrophy in the medial temporal lobe, and cerebrospinal fluid analysis reveals high levels of certain neurotoxic oligomers. Which of the following statements regarding the pathology and pathophysiology of this patient’s condition is false?

options.label: A
options.text: Soluble neurotoxic oligomers lead to synapse loss.

options.label: B
options.text: Neurofibrillary tangles contain hyperphosphorylated tau protein.

options.label: C
options.text: Plaques indicate polymerization of the neurotoxic proteins.
